title: Numerical evidence for the almost Hadamard conjecture
description:
We report numerical evidence for the almost Hadamard conjecture, which states that every local maximizer of the entrywise 1-norm on the unitary group U_N has all entries of modulus 1/sqrt(N), or equivalently that every complex almost Hadamard matrix is a complex Hadamard matrix. We study orders 4 and 5 through structural results, numerical searches and interval certificates. At order 5, we certify exact critical points near 40 nonflat representatives, local uniqueness modulo phases and Hessian inertia, obtaining at least 35 distinct nonflat critical values. These results support the conjecture without proving it in these orders.

This release contains the 30-page paper, its TeX source, 28 Python programs, certificate inputs and selected computational data. The manuscript byline is Chat, Grok and Teo.
